title: How to build the virtual cell with artificial intelligence: Priorities and opportunities
authors: Bunne C, Roohani Y, Rosen Y, Gupta A, Zhang X, Roed M, Alexandrov T, AlQuraishi M, Brennan P, Burkhardt DB, Califano A, Cool J, Dernburg AF, Ewing K, Fox EB, Haury M, Herr AE, Horvitz E, Hsu PD, Jain V, Johnson GR, Kalil T, Kelley DR, Kelley SO, Kreshuk A, Mitchison T, Otte S, Shendure J, Sofroniew NJ, Theis F, Theodoris CV, Upadhyayula S, Valer M, Wang B, Xing E, Yeung-Levy S, Zitnik M, Karaletsos T, Regev A, Lundberg E, Leskovec J, Quake SR.
summary_zh: 这篇前瞻提出用多尺度、多模态神经网络表示并模拟分子、细胞与组织，讨论构建虚拟细胞所需的数据、评价与协作。它提供整体研究愿景，适合先理解代谢模型在虚拟细胞中的位置。
why_read: 先理解虚拟细胞要支持哪些科学问题，再决定代谢模块该预测什么。
limitation: 文章提出研究议程，没有给出一个已经完成全部能力的虚拟细胞系统。
summary_en: This Perspective proposes multiscale, multimodal neural networks for representing and simulating molecules, cells, and tissues. It discusses the data, evaluation, and collaboration needed to build virtual cells, providing a useful starting point for understanding where metabolic modeling fits into the broader vision.
why_read_en: Identify the scientific questions a virtual cell should support before deciding what its metabolic component should predict.
limitation_en: The article sets out a research agenda; it does not present a completed system with all of the proposed capabilities.

title: Artificial intelligence revolutionizes cellular metabolic pathway reconstruction
authors: Zheng J, Xu X, Yang Q, Dong N, Li SZ.
summary_zh: 文章讨论如何把逆合成规划与生物约束结合，重建有生物可行性的代谢通路；同时连接单个通路和系统层面的建模，以及大语言模型参与理解、设计、评价和优化的可能方式。
why_read: 从通路设计与系统约束两端理解 AI 如何参与代谢研究。
limitation: 这是概念框架；具体路线的有效性仍需要依赖相应的模型与实验结果。
summary_en: The article discusses combining retrosynthetic planning with biological constraints to reconstruct biologically feasible metabolic pathways. It connects pathway-level and systems-level modeling and considers how large language models might contribute to understanding, designing, evaluating, and optimizing metabolic networks.
why_read_en: Understand AI for metabolism from both pathway design and systems constraints.
limitation_en: This is a conceptual framework. The effectiveness of individual approaches depends on their corresponding modeling and experimental results.

title: What is flux balance analysis?
authors: Orth JD, Thiele I, Palsson BØ.
summary_zh: 通量平衡分析的入门文章，介绍如何用化学计量矩阵、稳态质量守恒、反应上下界及目标函数刻画可行通量。它是理解基因组尺度代谢模型、酶约束模型与后续机器学习融合方法的理论起点。
why_read: 掌握 Sv=0、可行解空间和目标函数，后面的 GEM 工作才容易读懂。
limitation: FBA 依赖稳态、网络边界和目标函数；一个最优解不能自动代表细胞的真实通量。
summary_en: An introduction to flux balance analysis, covering stoichiometric matrices, steady-state mass balance, reaction bounds, and objective functions. It provides the theoretical starting point for genome-scale metabolic models, enzyme-constrained models, and later approaches that combine constraints with machine learning.
why_read_en: Learn Sv = 0, feasible flux spaces, and objective functions before moving on to GEM research.
limitation_en: FBA depends on steady-state assumptions, network boundaries, and the objective function. An optimal solution is not automatically the actual cellular flux state.

title: Improving the phenotype predictions of a yeast genome-scale metabolic model by incorporating enzymatic constraints
authors: Sánchez BJ, Zhang C, Nilsson A, Lahtvee PJ, Kerkhoven EJ, Nielsen J.
summary_zh: GECKO 把酶加入代谢反应约束，使每条通量受酶丰度和催化周转数的乘积限制。论文在酵母中比较不同碳源、胁迫和通路过表达，并展示如何把定量蛋白组接入模型，缩小可行通量范围。
why_read: 理解 GEM 如何变成酶约束 GEM，以及蛋白组和动力学参数各自提供什么信息。
limitation: 对酶丰度、动力学参数和酶容量的设置，会影响最后得到的通量范围。
summary_en: GECKO adds enzyme constraints to metabolic reactions, bounding flux by enzyme abundance multiplied by its turnover number. The yeast study examines carbon sources, stress, and pathway overexpression, and shows how quantitative proteomics can narrow the feasible flux space.
why_read_en: Understand how a GEM becomes an enzyme-constrained GEM and what information protein abundance and kinetic parameters each contribute.
limitation_en: The resulting flux ranges depend on how enzyme abundance, kinetic parameters, and enzyme capacities are specified.

title: Yeast9: a consensus genome-scale metabolic model for S. cerevisiae curated by the community
authors: Zhang C, Sánchez BJ, Li F, Eiden CWQ, Scott WT, Liebal UW, Blank LM, Mengers HG, Anton M, Rangel AT, Mendoza SN, Zhang L, Nielsen J, Lu H, Kerkhoven EJ.
summary_zh: 社区持续维护的酿酒酵母基因组尺度代谢模型。作者将单细胞转录组、蛋白组和大量突变株表达数据接入模型，研究渗透压和氮源适应，并比较模型通量表示与表达表示在功能预测中的表现。
why_read: 适合学习真实 GEM 如何维护、如何整合组学，以及如何设计遗传扰动分析。
limitation: 由表达约束得到的通量属于模型推断，需要与实测通量或独立表型核对。
summary_en: A community-maintained genome-scale metabolic model of Saccharomyces cerevisiae. The authors integrate single-cell transcriptomics, proteomics, and mutant expression data to study osmotic and nitrogen-source adaptation, and compare model-derived flux representations with expression representations for functional prediction.
why_read_en: Learn how a working GEM is maintained, how omics data are integrated, and how genetic perturbation analyses are designed.
limitation_en: Fluxes obtained by constraining a model with expression data are model inferences and should be checked against measured fluxes or independent phenotypes.

title: Deep learning-based kcat prediction enables improved enzyme-constrained model reconstruction
authors: Feiran Li, Le Yuan, Hongzhong Lu
summary_zh: DLKcat 从酶蛋白序列和底物结构预测催化周转数 kcat，并把预测参数接入酶约束模型的构建。它连接了酶级别的监督学习与系统级代谢表型预测，展示参数预测如何改变下游模型的用途。
why_read: 从序列和底物出发，追踪 AI 预测误差如何传到整个代谢网络。
limitation: 训练中的体外动力学值稀疏且有噪声；预测值不能直接等同于细胞内的实际周转数。
summary_en: DLKcat predicts enzyme turnover numbers, kcat, from protein sequences and substrate structures and uses those predictions to construct enzyme-constrained models. It connects enzyme-level supervised learning with systems-level phenotype prediction, showing how parameter prediction can affect downstream metabolic modeling.
why_read_en: Trace how errors in sequence- and substrate-based parameter prediction propagate through a metabolic network.
limitation_en: The in vitro kinetic training data are sparse and noisy. Predicted values should not be equated directly with actual intracellular turnover numbers.

title: Predicting metabolic fluxes from omics data via machine learning: Moving from knowledge-driven towards data-driven approaches
authors: Gonçalves DM, Henriques R, Costa RS.
method: 组学到通量的监督学习
summary_zh: 论文用大肠杆菌转录组、蛋白组和通量数据训练监督学习模型，比较内部与外部通量预测和简约 FBA 的表现。它提供一个直接切入点：先比较数据驱动映射与经典约束优化，再讨论两者如何结合。
why_read: 建立组学到通量的简单基线，弄清训练标签和目标条件。
limitation: 数据规模、条件划分和可用输入决定外推能力；目前没有核实 ML2Flux 是正式方法名。
method_en: Supervised learning from omics to flux
summary_en: The study trains supervised models on Escherichia coli transcriptomics, proteomics, and flux data and compares internal and external flux predictions with parsimonious FBA. It offers a direct entry point for comparing data-driven mappings with classical constraint-based optimization before considering their integration.
why_read_en: Establish simple omics-to-flux baselines and identify the training labels and target conditions.
limitation_en: Dataset size, condition splits, and available inputs determine extrapolation ability. ML2Flux has not been verified as the formal method name.

title: A neural-mechanistic hybrid approach improving the predictive power of genome-scale metabolic models
authors: Faure L, Mollet B, Liebermeister W, Faulon JL.
method: 神经网络与机制模型融合
summary_zh: 作者让神经网络与约束代谢模型共同预测微生物表型，在不同培养基和基因敲除条件下评估大肠杆菌及恶臭假单胞菌。该路线尝试用数据学习补充不充分的机制输入，同时保留反应网络的机制约束。
why_read: 学习神经网络究竟补了哪个未知量，以及机制约束如何进入训练和预测。
limitation: 模型仍需要训练表型；跨物种或超出培养条件的泛化，必须分别验证。
summary_en: The authors combine neural networks with constraint-based metabolic models to predict microbial phenotypes, evaluating E. coli and Pseudomonas putida under different media and gene-knockout conditions. The approach learns to compensate for incomplete mechanistic inputs while retaining metabolic network constraints.
why_read_en: Identify exactly which unknown quantity the neural network supplies and how mechanistic constraints enter training and prediction.
limitation_en: Training phenotypes are still required. Generalization across species or beyond the studied culture conditions must be evaluated separately.

title: A graph neural network model to estimate cell-wise metabolic flux using single-cell RNA-seq data
authors: Alghamdi N, Chang W, Dang P, Lu X, Wan C, Gampala S, Huang Z, Wang J, Ma Q, Zang Y, Fishel M, Cao S, Zhang C.
summary_zh: scFEA 把代谢网络表示为因子图，用图神经网络和通量平衡约束从单细胞 RNA 推断细胞级代谢通量。作者还生成配对代谢组与 RNA 数据，比较氧气和遗传扰动下的预测变化及代谢物变化。
why_read: 理解从 RNA 推断代谢状态的完整假设链，以及细胞异质性如何进入模型。
limitation: 验证中的代谢物丰度变化与通量直接测量不同，RNA 推断结果需要保留这一差别。
summary_en: scFEA represents a metabolic network as a factor graph and uses graph neural networks and flux-balance constraints to infer cell-wise metabolic flux from single-cell RNA data. The authors also generate matched metabolomics and RNA data to compare predicted changes with metabolite changes under oxygen and genetic perturbations.
why_read_en: Follow the assumptions linking RNA to metabolic state and examine how cell-to-cell heterogeneity enters the model.
limitation_en: Metabolite abundance changes used for validation differ from direct flux measurements. That distinction remains necessary when interpreting RNA-inferred flux.

title: EnzymeTuning improves enzyme-constrained metabolic modeling and proteome abundance prediction through deep learning
authors: Wang X, Wang Y, Zhuang Y, Wang G, Lu H.
summary_zh: EnzymeTuning 用生成对抗网络全局优化酶约束代谢模型中的 kcat，并结合蛋白降解常数推断蛋白合成率。作者在多种酵母与大肠杆菌中评价代谢模型和蛋白组丰度预测，分析不同营养限制下的酶资源分配。
why_read: 比较独立预测 kcat 与为系统模型联合优化参数这两种研究路线。
limitation: 优化后的参数服务于模型拟合；是否对应独立测得的细胞内酶动力学，需要额外核实。
summary_en: EnzymeTuning uses a generative adversarial network to optimize kcat values globally within enzyme-constrained metabolic models and incorporates protein degradation constants to infer protein synthesis rates. The authors evaluate metabolic and proteome-abundance predictions across yeast species and E. coli and examine enzyme allocation under nutrient limitation.
why_read_en: Compare predicting kcat independently with jointly optimizing parameters for a systems model.
limitation_en: Optimized parameters serve model fitting. Whether they correspond to independently measured intracellular enzyme kinetics requires additional verification.

title: COBRApy: COnstraints-Based Reconstruction and Analysis for Python
authors: Ebrahim A, Lerman JA, Palsson BO, Hyduke DR.
summary_zh: COBRApy 提供 Python 接口建立、修改和分析约束代谢模型，是运行 FBA、基因删除和模型分析的常用工具。读完 FBA 基础后，可以用它把化学计量矩阵、培养基和基因反应关系转化成可执行实验。
why_read: 作为动手入口，复现最简单的生长预测和单基因删除实验。
limitation: 软件工具提供求解能力；模型的生物学正确性仍取决于网络和约束。
summary_en: COBRApy provides Python interfaces for building, modifying, and analyzing constraint-based metabolic models. After learning FBA, readers can use it to turn stoichiometry, media definitions, and gene-reaction relationships into executable analyses such as growth prediction and gene deletion.
why_read_en: Start with hands-on reproduction of simple growth predictions and single-gene deletions.
limitation_en: The software provides analysis and solver access; biological correctness still depends on the network and its constraints.

title: Creation and analysis of biochemical constraint-based models using the COBRA Toolbox v.3.0
authors: Heirendt L, Arreckx S, Pfau T, Mendoza SN, Richelle A, Heinken A, Haraldsdóttir HS, Wachowiak J, Keating SM, Vlasov V, Magnusdóttir S, Ng CY, Preciat G, Žagare A, Chan SHJ, Aurich MK, Clancy CM, Modamio J, Sauls JT, Noronha A, Bordbar A, Cousins B, El Assal DC, Valcarcel LV, Apaolaza I, Ghaderi S, Ahookhosh M, Ben Guebila M, Kostromins A, Sompairac N, Le HM, Ma D, Sun Y, Wang L, Yurkovich JT, Oliveira MAP, Vuong PT, El Assal LP, Kuperstein I, Zinovyev A, Hinton HS, Bryant WA, Aragón Artacho FJ, Planes FJ, Stalidzans E, Maass A, Vempala S, Hucka M, Saunders MA, Maranas CD, Lewis NE, Sauter T, Palsson BØ, Thiele I, Fleming RMT.
summary_zh: 这篇协议系统介绍如何建立和分析生化约束模型，覆盖模型重建、分析与多种应用。它适合与 FBA 入门配合使用，帮助读者把一个数学优化问题扩展为规范的代谢模型工作流程。
why_read: 查阅约束建模的标准操作、分析方法与可复现流程。
limitation: 教程包含多种方法，实际研究需要按数据和目标选择，而非全部套用。
summary_en: This protocol describes the construction and analysis of biochemical constraint-based models, including reconstruction, analysis, and applications. It complements introductory FBA material by expanding a mathematical optimization problem into a structured metabolic modeling workflow.
why_read_en: Consult standard procedures, analytical methods, and reproducible workflows for constraint-based modeling.
limitation_en: The protocol includes many methods. A study should select those appropriate to its data and objective rather than apply them all.

title: MEMOTE for standardized genome-scale metabolic model testing
authors: Lieven C, Beber ME, Olivier BG, Bergmann FT, Ataman M, Babaei P, Bartell JA, Blank LM, Chauhan S, Correia K, Diener C, Dräger A, Ebert BE, Edirisinghe JN, Faria JP, Feist AM, Fengos G, Fleming RMT, García-Jiménez B, Hatzimanikatis V, van Helvoirt W, Henry CS, Hermjakob H, Herrgård MJ, Kaafarani A, Kim HU, King Z, Klamt S, Klipp E, Koehorst JJ, König M, Lakshmanan M, Lee DY, Lee SY, Lee S, Lewis NE, Liu F, Ma H, Machado D, Mahadevan R, Maia P, Mardinoglu A, Medlock GL, Monk JM, Nielsen J, Nielsen LK, Nogales J, Nookaew I, Palsson BO, Papin JA, Patil KR, Poolman M, Price ND, Resendis-Antonio O, Richelle A, Rocha I, Sánchez BJ, Schaap PJ, Malik Sheriff RS, Shoaie S, Sonnenschein N, Teusink B, Vilaça P, Vik JO, Wodke JAH, Xavier JC, Yuan Q, Zakhartsev M, Zhang C.
summary_zh: MEMOTE 为基因组尺度代谢模型建立标准化测试，检查注释、化学计量一致性等模型质量问题。它把模型重建后的技术验证变成可以重复执行和比较的流程，适合所有新模型或自动重建项目作为基础检查。
why_read: 在比较预测性能前，先检查模型本身是否满足基本结构与一致性要求。
limitation: 结构和注释测试通过，不等同于生长、扰动或通量预测已得到实验验证。
summary_en: MEMOTE introduces standardized tests for genome-scale metabolic models, including annotation and stoichiometric consistency checks. It turns technical validation after reconstruction into a repeatable, comparable workflow and provides useful foundational checks for new or automatically reconstructed models.
why_read_en: Check structural and consistency requirements before comparing predictive performance.
limitation_en: Passing structural and annotation tests does not establish experimental validity for growth, perturbation, or flux predictions.

title: An atlas of human metabolism
authors: Robinson JL, Kocabaş P, Wang H, Cholley PE, Cook D, Nilsson A, Anton M, Ferreira R, Domenzain I, Billa V, Limeta A, Hedin A, Gustafsson J, Kerkhoven EJ, Svensson LT, Palsson BO, Mardinoglu A, Hansson L, Uhlén M, Nielsen J.
summary_zh: Human1 将既有的人类代谢重建整合成统一模型，为组学数据分析和组织、疾病相关代谢研究提供共同起点。它适合与酵母模型并读，理解人类细胞的代谢网络、基因注释与条件化分析如何衔接。
why_read: 从微生物过渡到人类细胞时，使用一个有持续维护基础的参考模型。
limitation: 通用人类网络需要按组织、细胞状态和培养条件设置，不能直接视为特定细胞的模型。
summary_en: Human1 integrates previous human metabolic reconstructions into a unified model for omics analysis and tissue- and disease-related metabolism research. Reading it alongside yeast models helps explain how human metabolic networks, gene annotations, and condition-specific analyses fit together.
why_read_en: Use a maintained reference model when moving from microorganisms to human cells.
limitation_en: A generic human network must be adapted to tissue, cell state, and culture conditions; it is not automatically a model of a particular cell.

title: Recon3D enables a three-dimensional view of gene variation in human metabolism
authors: Brunk E, Sahoo S, Zielinski DC, Altunkaya A, Dräger A, Mih N, Gatto F, Nilsson A, Preciat Gonzalez GA, Aurich MK, Prlić A, Sastry A, Danielsdottir AD, Heinken A, Noronha A, Rose PW, Burley SK, Fleming RMT, Nielsen J, Thiele I, Palsson BO.
summary_zh: Recon3D 将人类代谢网络和蛋白三维结构等信息联系起来，支持分析基因变异对代谢功能的可能影响。它提供从基因、酶结构到系统代谢表型的跨尺度组织方式，是理解机制约束如何扩充的重要资源。
why_read: 了解人类 GEM 如何连接蛋白结构与遗传变异。
limitation: 把结构信息映射到网络，并不自动确定每个变异的细胞内动力学效应。
summary_en: Recon3D links the human metabolic network with information including protein three-dimensional structures to analyze potential metabolic consequences of genetic variation. It illustrates a multiscale organization from genes and enzyme structures to systems-level phenotypes.
why_read_en: Understand how human GEMs can connect protein structure and genetic variation.
limitation_en: Mapping structural information onto a network does not determine the intracellular kinetic effect of every variant.

title: The Virtual Metabolic Human database: integrating human and gut microbiome metabolism with nutrition and disease
authors: Noronha A, Modamio J, Jarosz Y, Guerard E, Sompairac N, Preciat G, Daníelsdóttir AD, Krecke M, Merten D, Haraldsdóttir HS, Heinken A, Heirendt L, Magnúsdóttir S, Ravcheev DA, Sahoo S, Gawron P, Friscioni L, Garcia B, Prendergast M, Puente A, Rodrigues M, Roy A, Rouquaya M, Wiltgen L, Žagare A, John E, Krueger M, Kuperstein I, Zinovyev A, Schneider R, Fleming RMT, Thiele I.
summary_zh: Virtual Metabolic Human 将人类和肠道微生物代谢与营养、疾病信息整合到数据库中。它提供跨宿主、微生物和饮食的反应与代谢物索引，可以作为搭建代谢研究数据入口和检查标识符的参考。
why_read: 查代谢物、反应和生物背景，了解宿主与微生物代谢的组织方式。
limitation: 数据库中的关联和模型条目需要按具体研究情境核实，不能替代条件化测量。
summary_en: The Virtual Metabolic Human database integrates human and gut microbial metabolism with nutrition and disease information. It indexes reactions and metabolites across host, microbes, and diet and is a useful reference for organizing metabolic research resources and checking identifiers.
why_read_en: Look up metabolites, reactions, and biological context and explore the organization of host and microbial metabolism.
limitation_en: Database associations and model entries need interpretation in the specific study context and do not replace condition-specific measurements.

title: Fast automated reconstruction of genome-scale metabolic models for microbial species and communities
authors: Machado D, Andrejev S, Tramontano M, Patil KR.
summary_zh: CarveMe 自动从通用模型出发，为微生物物种和群落重建基因组尺度代谢网络。它让重建成为可重复的计算流程，适合研究大规模自动建模、网络缺口和群落代谢交换。
why_read: 理解自动重建与人工审校之间的分工，建立微生物模型作为方法实验平台。
limitation: 自动重建和补洞依赖先验与培养条件，关键反应和预测表型仍需审查。
summary_en: CarveMe automatically reconstructs genome-scale metabolic models for microbial species and communities from a universal model. It makes reconstruction a repeatable computational process and provides a platform for studying large-scale modeling, network gaps, and community metabolic exchange.
why_read_en: Understand the roles of automated reconstruction and manual curation, and build microbial models for methodological experiments.
limitation_en: Automated reconstruction and gap filling depend on prior knowledge and culture conditions. Key reactions and predicted phenotypes still require review.

title: UniKP: a unified framework for the prediction of enzyme kinetic parameters
authors: Yu H, Deng H, He J, Keasling JD, Luo X.
summary_zh: UniKP 将蛋白质和底物表示用于预测多类酶动力学参数。它可以与 DLKcat 对照阅读，比较数据整理、序列与化学表示、参数预测任务以及对酶工程和系统建模的用途。
why_read: 横向比较 kcat、Km 等参数的学习问题，建立简单且可检查的基线。
limitation: 相近序列和相同底物如何分到训练与测试，会显著影响对泛化能力的解释。
summary_en: UniKP uses protein and substrate representations to predict multiple enzyme kinetic parameters. It can be read alongside DLKcat to compare data curation, sequence and chemical representations, prediction tasks, and applications to enzyme engineering and systems modeling.
why_read_en: Compare the learning problems for kcat, Km, and related parameters and establish simple, inspectable baselines.
limitation_en: How similar sequences and identical substrates are assigned to training and test sets strongly affects the interpretation of generalization.

title: Metabolic modeling of single Th17 cells reveals regulators of autoimmunity
authors: Wagner A, Wang C, Fessler J, DeTomaso D, Avila-Pacheco J, Kaminski J, Zaghouani S, Christian E, Thakore P, Schellhaass B, Akama-Garren E, Pierce K, Singh V, Ron-Harel N, Douglas VP, Bod L, Schnell A, Puleston D, Sobel RA, Haigis M, Pearce EL, Soleimani M, Clish C, Regev A, Kuchroo VK, Yosef N.
summary_zh: Compass 结合单细胞 RNA 和代谢网络分析 Th17 细胞的代谢状态，提出与致病潜力有关的多胺代谢假设。作者通过代谢实验、化学与遗传扰动及体内研究检验候选，展示计算代谢分析如何引导生物学实验。
why_read: 观察从转录组推断、候选通路选择到功能实验的具体研究过程。
limitation: 计算得分描述网络支持的代谢状态，不能直接当作每个细胞实测的绝对通量。
summary_en: Compass combines single-cell RNA with metabolic network analysis to characterize Th17 metabolic states and propose polyamine-metabolism hypotheses related to pathogenic potential. Metabolic assays, chemical and genetic perturbations, and in vivo studies test the candidates, illustrating how computational analysis can guide experiments.
why_read_en: Follow the concrete sequence from transcriptomic inference through pathway selection to functional experiments.
limitation_en: Computational scores describe network-supported metabolic states and should not be treated as directly measured absolute fluxes in individual cells.

title: Characterizing cancer metabolism from bulk and single-cell RNA-seq data using METAFlux
authors: Huang Y, Mohanty V, Dede M, Tsai K, Daher M, Li L, Rezvani K, Chen K.
summary_zh: METAFlux 使用整体和单细胞 RNA 数据刻画肿瘤代谢，把基因表达与约束代谢建模连接起来。它与 scFEA、Compass 提供互补入口，适合比较网络定义、细胞间差异和下游验证如何影响结论。
why_read: 用同一生物学问题比较不同 RNA 到代谢推断方法。
limitation: 转录水平到反应活性的映射含有假设，不能仅凭几种方法结果一致就确定真实通量。
summary_en: METAFlux links gene expression with constraint-based modeling to characterize cancer metabolism from bulk and single-cell RNA data. Alongside scFEA and Compass, it provides an entry point for comparing network definitions, cellular differences, and downstream validation.
why_read_en: Compare different RNA-to-metabolism inference methods on the same biological question.
limitation_en: Mapping transcription to reaction activity involves assumptions. Agreement between methods alone does not establish the actual flux state.

title: Inferring metabolic objectives and trade-offs in single cells during embryogenesis
authors: Lin DW, Zhang L, Zhang J, Chandrasekaran S.
summary_zh: SCOOTI 结合组学、代谢建模和机器学习，推断单细胞所优先满足的代谢目标及其取舍。作者在胚胎发育、细胞周期和静息状态中分析目标变化，并用 CRISPR 筛选中的必需基因等结果验证推断。
why_read: 从固定最大化生物量，转向研究不同细胞实际优先满足什么代谢需求。
limitation: 推断目标依赖模型和候选目标集合，独立功能测量仍决定其生物学解释。
summary_en: SCOOTI combines omics, metabolic modeling, and machine learning to infer metabolic objectives and trade-offs in single cells. The authors analyze embryonic development, cell-cycle phases, and quiescence and validate inferences using evidence including essential genes from CRISPR screens.
why_read_en: Move beyond a fixed biomass-maximization objective to ask which metabolic needs different cells prioritize.
limitation_en: Inferred objectives depend on the model and candidate objective set. Independent functional measurements remain important for their biological interpretation.

title: gpuGEM: GPU-based linear optimisation of genome-scale metabolic models
authors: Farid Zare†, Timothy Hulshof†, Ines Thiele, Ronan M. T. Fleming
summary_zh: 作者发布开源 Python 库 gpuGEM，把 FBA 及其耦合约束写成线性规划后交给 NVIDIA cuOpt 的 PDLP 求解器，并给出按反应数 10 万为界的大小自适应精度、容差与预求解设置。在覆盖 95 到 118 万变量、共十个模型的基准上，以目标值、原始可行性与边界满足性对照 HiGHS 与 Gurobi，报告 1.1 到 94 倍加速；其中八个模型的客观反应由自身边界钉住，该项一致只算一致性检查。另在候选基因优先级流程中把端到端时间从 41 秒降到 21 秒。
why_read: 基因敲除扫描、通量变异分析、模型个体化和队列研究都要成百上千次求解，求解器耗时直接决定可行性。这篇把求解器选择、可行性与数值稳定性当成主要变量来验证，并给出可复现的开源栈，对把 GEM 工作流接进 GPU 训练与推理管线有直接参考价值。
limitation: 方法页正文在 Results 一节因 LaTeXML 转换失败而截断，大模型加速倍数、残差放宽与迭代次数关系等细节只能在摘要层面采信。所报加速来自单一工作站（RTX A4500），且未评估不同退化程度模型上可行性判定的生物后果，实际收益需自行复现。
new_question: 当 GEM 线性规划因退化与病态而在 GPU 上收敛出不同可行点时，应当如何定义并报告生物解释的可接受误差，而不是只比较目标值？
summary_en: The open-source gpuGEM library formulates FBA and coupled constraints as linear programs for the NVIDIA cuOpt PDLP solver, using size-dependent precision, tolerances, and presolve settings. Across ten models with 95 to 1.18 million variables, the authors compare objective values, primal feasibility, and bound satisfaction with HiGHS and Gurobi and report 1.1- to 94-fold speedups. In eight models the objective reaction is fixed by its bounds, so agreement there is only a consistency check. A candidate-gene prioritization workflow falls from 41 to 21 seconds.
why_read_en: Gene-deletion scans, flux variability analysis, personalized models, and cohort studies require repeated solves. The study examines solver choice, feasibility, and numerical stability and offers an open implementation relevant to GPU-based GEM workflows.
limitation_en: The accessible HTML conversion is truncated in Results, so some acceleration, residual-tolerance, and iteration details were verified only at abstract level. Speedups come from a single RTX A4500 workstation. Biological consequences of feasibility decisions across models with different degeneracy were not evaluated; practical gains require reproduction.

title: Uncertainty-aware integration of deuterium metabolic imaging with genome-scale metabolic modeling reveals diet-associated feasible-space remodeling in mouse skeletal muscle
authors: Tin Yau Pang, Samia Maouhoub, Maruf Khan, Andreas Korzowski, Michael Roden, Ulrich Flögel, Daniel Dörr
summary_zh: 预印本建立一条不确定性感知流程，把动态氘代谢成像数据以软通量约束接入基因组尺度代谢模型。对对照与高脂饮食小鼠的腓肠肌、比目鱼肌与胫骨前肌采集 [6,6'-2H2] 葡萄糖注射后的动态谱，用层级四态动力学模型估计标记参数。因葡萄糖标记比乳酸和谷氨酸/谷氨酰胺信号可靠，只用两个量做锚点：葡萄糖处理映射到己糖激酶通量，葡萄糖来源的氧化进入映射到丙酮酸脱氢酶通量。以上内容依据摘要。
why_read: 它示范了一种把有噪声的在体示踪信号以区间形式而非点估计接入 GEM 的做法，并明确指出哪些信号不可靠就排除，对判断可行性通量区间与实测通量之间的边界、以及如何报告通量变异分析结果有直接参考。
limitation: 仅有摘要，未核实可行性区间相对数据驱动的具体稳健性、重采样策略与是否用独立示踪数据交叉验证；因此文中各亚系统可行性改变的幅度与高脂饮食差异的可信度目前无法确认，只能作为待核对的线索。
new_question: 在体示踪成像只能可靠约束少数反应时，应当以何种软约束结构和区间来定义可行域，才能让下游通量解读避免对未可靠识别的信号下强结论？
summary_en: This preprint proposes an uncertainty-aware workflow that integrates dynamic deuterium metabolic imaging into GEMs through soft flux constraints. Dynamic spectra follow labeled glucose administration in three muscle types in control and high-fat-diet mice, with a hierarchical four-state kinetic model for labeling. Because glucose labeling is more reliable than lactate and glutamate/glutamine signals, only two anchors are used: glucose handling mapped to hexokinase flux, and glucose-derived oxidative entry mapped to pyruvate dehydrogenase flux. This description is based on the abstract.
why_read_en: Consider how noisy in vivo tracer signals can constrain GEMs through intervals rather than point estimates, and how unreliable signals are excluded. This helps distinguish feasible flux ranges from directly measured fluxes when interpreting flux variability analysis.
limitation_en: Only the abstract was checked. The robustness of the inferred intervals, resampling strategy, and independent tracer validation remain unverified. The magnitude and reliability of subsystem and high-fat-diet effects therefore remain uncertain.

title: Going beyond labels: Semi-supervised learning for enzyme kinetic parameter prediction
authors: Malli A, Vasyutyn D, Majumder A, Kim JR.
summary_zh: 预印本提出用正则化半监督学习改进 kcat 预测：不给无标签样本打伪标签，而是把缺少 kcat、但有其他动力学参数记录的酶-底物对当作无标签数据，与有标签数据一起参与任务训练。以按 40% 序列一致性聚类的 CataPro 数据集为基准，神经一致性正则与图拉普拉斯正则各在加入无标签记录后好于仅用有标签正则；收益需要充足有标签数据，在数千条无标签记录处饱和。以上内容依据摘要。
why_read: 酶约束模型的瓶颈是 kcat 标注稀少且覆盖偏窄，这篇把不完整动力学记录视为可用信息，并给出特征空间密度而非近邻关系的判别，可作为构建酶参数训练集与划分基准时的思路参考。
limitation: 目前只能依据摘要判断，缺少数据集划分细节、是否按序列簇或酶家族留出的明确说明，以及增益在独立外部数据集上的幅度；页面未提供可核实的酶约束模型端表现，因此不能据此评估对预测通量的实际影响。
new_question: 无标签数据在特征空间的密度而非与有标签样本的距离决定增益，这对 kcat 预测的数据采集与基准划分提出了什么新要求？
summary_en: This preprint proposes regularized semi-supervised kcat prediction using enzyme-substrate pairs that lack kcat but have other kinetic records. Rather than assign pseudo-labels, it trains with labeled and unlabeled examples together. On CataPro data clustered at 40% sequence identity, neural consistency and graph Laplacian regularization reportedly benefit from unlabeled records; gains require sufficient labeled data and saturate after several thousand unlabeled records. This description is based on the abstract.
why_read_en: Explore incomplete kinetic records as additional information for sparse kcat prediction and consider the role of feature-space density, rather than only proximity, when constructing training sets and benchmarks.
limitation_en: Only the abstract was checked. Detailed splits, explicit sequence-cluster or enzyme-family holdouts, and gains on independent external datasets remain unverified. There is no verified downstream enzyme-constrained-model evaluation, so effects on flux prediction cannot yet be assessed.

title: AI-enabled fungal biomanufacturing: from genome mining to the artificial intelligence virtual cell
authors: Wang Z, Chen X, Gu S, Wang P, Li J, Zhou S, Zhang S.
summary_zh: 这是一篇综述，梳理 AI 在丝状真菌生物制造中的作用，覆盖基因组挖掘、酶与通路分析、基因组编辑、代谢网络建模和发酵控制，并把组学、机制模型与机器学习整合表述为 AIVC 统一多尺度框架。文中强调真菌必须有隔室化代谢、复杂分泌与形态依赖产量等真核特异性，且把数据质量与标准化、跨尺度整合与可解释性、以及计算预测和实验验证之间的差距列为关键挑战。
why_read: 它在阅读路径上把 GEM 与机器学习融合放到具体生物制造场景中，明确虚拟细胞在真核体系中必须补上隔室与分泌两类结构，可作为判断 AIVC 类工作是否真正超出任务级拼装问题的检查清单。
limitation: 全文以条目式回顾为主，未给出跨尺度融合的定量基准、误差传播分析或新验证实验；对真菌 GEM 的评述只提到已有模型与动态 FBA 的历史案例，读者无法据此判断 AIVC 框架相对现有混合模型的增量收益。
new_question: 真菌的隔室化代谢与形态依赖产量应当以何种信息结构进入统一模型，才能在跨尺度上保持可辨识并可被实验验证？
summary_en: This review surveys AI for filamentous fungal biomanufacturing, spanning genome mining, enzymes and pathways, genome editing, metabolic modeling, and fermentation control. It presents omics, mechanistic models, and machine learning within a unified multiscale virtual-cell framework, emphasizing compartmentalized metabolism, secretion, and morphology-dependent production alongside data quality, cross-scale integration, interpretability, and experimental validation.
why_read_en: Connect GEMs and machine learning to a concrete manufacturing context. The discussion of compartments and secretion helps assess whether a proposed virtual-cell framework addresses fungal biology beyond a collection of separate tasks.
limitation_en: The review provides no new quantitative benchmark, error-propagation analysis, or validation experiments for the proposed cross-scale integration. Its discussion of fungal GEMs cites existing models and dynamic FBA examples, leaving the added benefit over current hybrid models unresolved.

title: An experimentally validated manually curated genome-scale metabolic model of Enterococcus faecium TX0016 reproduces high-throughput phenotyping data
authors: Rasmi D, Krishnan K, Hashem Y, Palsson B, Kashef M, Monk J, Aziz R.
summary_zh: 作者基于心内膜炎患者分离株 TX0016 的手工重建得到 iDR478，用 COBRApy 0.25 与 glpk 做 FBA，依 BiGG 与粪肠球菌模板模型设定可逆性边界并用间隙填充补全网络，再进行表型验证。以 0.078 h⁻¹ 生长阈值判定，模型对 Biolog 判定可利用的 46 种碳源预测出 40 种，准确率 86.9%，其中 6 种为假阴性；氨基酸缺失实验的必需性判定与实验完全一致；但基因必需性只有 MCC 0.27、灵敏度 0.39，作者归因于表达调控与表型端点差异。
why_read: 这是少见的把手工重建、高通量表型验证和诚实错误分解写在一起的案例。对判断一个同物种模型能否用于营养控制、培养基设计与基因必需性筛选，它给出了可比较的基准线，也明确示范了不同验证端点之间的差距如何改变结论。
limitation: 验证集中在单一菌株与批量表型芯片，未使用同位素示踪或实测通量；基因必需性 MCC 0.27 意味着直接用该模型做必需基因或药物靶点筛选会产生大量假阳性和假阴性，报告中未给出在给定假阳性率下可容许的使用边界。
new_question: 在模型表型验证与基因必需性验证给出截然不同结论时，应当如何定义模型可用范围并据此设计培养基与筛选，而不是只报告一个总体准确率？
summary_en: The authors manually curated iDR478 for endocarditis isolate TX0016, ran FBA with COBRApy 0.25 and glpk, set reversibility bounds from BiGG and the E. faecalis template model, filled network gaps, and then validated phenotypes. Using a 0.078 per hour growth threshold, the model predicted growth on 40 of the 46 Biolog substrates scored as utilised, an accuracy of 86.9%, with six false negatives. Essentiality predictions for amino-acid dropout experiments agreed fully with the experiments, whereas gene essentiality reached only an MCC of 0.27 and sensitivity 0.39, which the authors attribute to transcriptional regulation and differing phenotype endpoints.
why_read_en: It is a rare case that puts manual curation, high-throughput phenotype validation and an honest error breakdown in one paper. It supplies a comparable baseline for deciding whether a same-species model supports nutrient control, medium design and gene-essentiality screening, and shows concretely how different validation endpoints change conclusions.
limitation_en: Validation rests on a single strain and bulk phenotype microarrays without isotope tracing or measured fluxes. A gene-essentiality MCC of 0.27 implies that using this model directly for essential-gene or drug-target screening will produce many false positives and negatives, and the paper does not state the operating range that is acceptable at a given false-positive rate.
method_en: Manually curated GEM with FBA, gap filling and Biolog / auxotrophy validation

title: FluxSprout: Single-cell metabolic modeling of vascular sprouting in zebrafish
authors: Zargar MR, Chowdhury R.
summary_zh: 预印本提出 FluxSprout 框架，把 10,090 个质控后的单细胞转录组数据与 Zebrafish-GEM 结合，为 14 种内皮与造血状态重建网络集合，并设四道审计：化学计量审计、环路审计、细胞周期对照测试与集合特异性筛选。结果指出四个被误注为氧化磷酸化的焦磷酸酶反应，只要交换通量不受限就会造成虚假通路必需性；19.5% 的反应可携带热力学不可行环路通量，而常规筛选的全部候选都在其中；在 825 个基因与四种网络提取设置下，没有一个候选被多于一个设置同时选中。以上内容依据摘要。
why_read: 它把网络注释不确定性、热力学可行性和集合特异性当作与通量预测同等重要的评价对象，并用具体数字说明常规单细胞代谢筛选有多容易被重建假象带走。对设计单细胞代谢推断的评价协议、以及判断某个候选靶点是否稳健，是可直接套用的检查清单。
limitation: 作者自认数据来自单一 pooled clutch 且需实验验证；更关键的是目前只读到摘要，四道审计的具体实现、细胞周期对照如何定义、以及转录组如何进入通量约束均未核实，无法判断这些折扣比例在其他组织或模型上是否同样成立。
new_question: 如果大多数单细胞代谢靶点在合理的网络集合与通量约束下都不稳健，那么单细胞代谢推断应当以何种可检验的信息结构输出，才能让下游实验选择有确定的成功概率？
summary_en: The preprint introduces FluxSprout, a framework that combines 10,090 quality-controlled single-cell transcriptomes with Zebrafish-GEM to reconstruct network ensembles for 14 endothelial and haemogenic states, guarded by four audits: stoichiometric, loop, cell-cycle-controlled testing and ensemble specificity screening. It reports four inorganic pyrophosphatase reactions misannotated as oxidative phosphorylation that create apparent pathway essentiality only when exchange fluxes are unbounded; 19.5% of reactions could carry thermodynamically infeasible loop flux, including every candidate of a conventional screen; and across 825 genes and four network-extraction settings, no candidate was called by more than one setting. These statements are based on the abstract only.
why_read_en: It treats network annotation uncertainty, thermodynamic feasibility and ensemble specificity as evaluation targets on par with flux prediction, and quantifies how easily a conventional single-cell metabolic screen is driven by reconstruction artefacts. It is a directly reusable checklist for designing evaluation protocols for single-cell metabolic inference and for judging candidate robustness.
limitation_en: The authors state the data come from a single pooled clutch and require experimental validation. More importantly, only the abstract was read, so the exact implementation of the four audits, the definition of the cell-cycle control and how transcriptomes enter flux constraints were not verified, leaving open whether these discount factors hold for other tissues or models.
method_en: scRNA-seq-informed ensemble GEM modelling with four audit safeguards

title: A Two-Stage ESM-Based Machine Learning Pipeline for Robust Hierarchically Evaluated Enzyme Function Prediction.
authors: Hua X, Grimaud GM.
summary_zh: 作者构建 ESM-ECForest 两段式流程：先用 ESM-2 蛋白语言模型产生固定长度嵌入，再用随机森林在 UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot 2026_01 构建的数据上先区分酶与非酶，随后对判定为酶的蛋白做 EC 层次多标签预测。在两万五千余条序列的外部基准上，加权 F1 从 EC 一级 0.94 降至四级 0.90；消融显示若用真实酶状态替代预测门控，四级加权 F1 从 0.902 升到 0.921，去掉门控则降至 0.863，说明误差主要来自门控而非 EC 分类本身。
why_read: 酶注释是 GEM 反应与基因映射的上游入口，错误注释会直接变成网络里的假反应。这篇把评分按 EC 层级拆开，并明确误差来自门控而不是分类，对决定是否值得把语言模型注释接进重建流程、以及在哪一层补人工核查，有直接的判断价值。
limitation: 只用 UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot 构建训练与验证集，评估被限制在训练中出现的分类与 EC 标签空间；未报告在未参与训练的微生物基因组或宏基因组上的表现，也未给出注释错误传播到 GEM 的定量影响。
new_question: 当酶注释的误差主要由门控这一上游二分类决定时，重建流程应当如何在门控置信度与水解平衡之间分配人工核查预算？
summary_en: ESM-ECForest is a two-stage pipeline that first converts proteins into fixed-length embeddings with the ESM-2 protein language model, then uses random forests trained on UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot 2026_01 to separate enzymes from non-enzymes and finally assign EC numbers hierarchically to predicted enzymes. On an external benchmark of 25,778 sequences, weighted F1 fell from 0.94 at EC level 1 to 0.90 at level 4. Ablations show that replacing the predicted gate with true enzyme status raises level-4 weighted F1 from 0.902 to 0.921, while removing the gate drops it to 0.863, indicating that gate errors, not EC assignment, dominate.
why_read_en: Enzyme annotation is the upstream entry into GEM reaction and gene mapping, so misannotation becomes spurious network reactions. Splitting scores by EC level and attributing error to the gate rather than to EC assignment directly informs whether language-model annotation is worth wiring into reconstruction and at which level manual review is needed.
limitation_en: Training and validation used only UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot, so evaluation is confined to the taxonomic and EC-label space represented during training. Performance on unrepresented microbial genomes or metagenomes is not reported, and the downstream effect of annotation errors on a GEM is not quantified.
method_en: Two-stage ESM-2 embeddings plus random forest EC classification

title: Nutrient control enables metabolic reconstruction of Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG and analysis of secretions.
authors: Richmond GR, Cunha E, Kelly L, Dias Ó, Chang RL.
summary_zh: 作者为益生菌鼠李糖乳杆菌 GG（LGG）给出首个手工整理基因组尺度代谢模型，做法是联合多个自动草稿模型、已发表研究文献与高通量确定成分培养基实验完成重建与验证。结果包含一系列化学确定成分培养基、大量单组分营养缺失生长数据，以及关于分泌产物、乳酸与吲哚-3-甲醛的计算与体外对照，并据此刻画 LGG 的最小营养需求。此条依据摘要，因该刊非开放获取且无 PMCID，未取得全文。
why_read: 营养需求数据是约束可用性的直接来源。与只做网络拓扑重建的草稿模型相比，这类以营养缺失实验闭环的重建方式，是判断模型能否可信地用于培养基设计与肠道环境模拟的关键依据。
limitation: 未取得全文，实验重复数、具体生长判定阈值、模型预测与体外实验结果的一致性程度均无法核实；因此在确认这些数字之前，不应把该模型当作已验证的代谢模拟工具引用。
new_question: 在多源草稿模型、文献与缺失实验共同作为证据时，应当如何给每条反应分配并累计置信度，才能使重建过程可审计？
summary_en: The authors present the first curated genome-scale model for the probiotic Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG, reconstructed and validated by combining several automatically generated drafts, published studies and high-throughput defined-medium experiments. The results include a set of chemically defined media, extensive single-component nutrient dropout growth data, in silico plus in vitro comparisons of secretion products, lactate and indole-3-carboxaldehyde, and an in silico characterisation of LGG nutrient requirements. This entry rests on the abstract because the article is not open access and has no PMCID, so full text was not obtained.
why_read_en: Nutrient requirement data are a direct source of usable constraints. Compared with draft models built on topology alone, this phenotype-closed reconstruction is the key evidence for judging whether a model can be trusted for medium design and gut-environment simulation.
limitation_en: Full text was not obtained, so replicate counts, the specific growth-call thresholds and the agreement between model predictions and in vitro results cannot be verified. Until those numbers are checked the model should not be cited as an experimentally validated simulation tool.
method_en: Literature and defined-media driven manual reconstruction of an LGG GEM
